ABB.name: ABB Migration
ABB.desc: Turns an ABB Freelance 2016 export into a DeltaV migration package: readable logic drawings, IO and tag lists, and what each block becomes in DeltaV. No Freelance licence needed.

DeltaV.name: LiveTools
DeltaV.desc: Report on, edit and bulk-change DeltaV Live graphics (.ahc): find and replace, thumbnails, compare, library analysis and translation.

DeltaV.name: DvHistExport
DeltaV.desc: Export DeltaV Continuous Historian data to CSV: connect to a historian node, find your tags, and pull the samples for any time range.

DeltaV.name: SuperOPCWatchIt
DeltaV.desc: Browse and watch DeltaV tags live over OPC, import or export tag lists as CSV, and keep a log of every value you write.

DeltaV.name: DifFHX
DeltaV.desc: Compare two DeltaV FHX exports — line by line, as configured modules, and as sequence logic — with the differences reported in Excel, PDF or HTML.

DeltaV.name: FHXport
DeltaV.desc: Turn a DeltaV FHX export into ready-made reports: interlocks, alarms, IO, modules, equipment modules, phases, historian, named sets, PID tuning and more.

DeltaV.name: FHXEdit
DeltaV.desc: Edit DeltaV FHX files in a tree view, with advanced find and replace, bulk delete, split, trim and partial export.

DeltaV.name: WebFHX
DeltaV.desc: Turn a DeltaV FHX export into a standalone web page anyone can open, with the module hierarchy and optional logic drawings.

DeltaV.name: EMTools
DeltaV.desc: Build DeltaV Equipment Modules from templates with a visual logic editor, move class parameters in and out as CSV, and auto-comment SFC steps.

DeltaV.name: FHXMerge
DeltaV.desc: Merge two or more DeltaV FHX files, resolving conflicts element by element in a side-by-side view.

DeltaV.name: FMTTools
DeltaV.desc: Build, export and check DeltaV user-defined import/export formats and their data files. Replaces FMTMaker, FMTExport and ModExport.

DeltaV.name: CEMatrix
DeltaV.desc: Generate an interactive interlock (cause and effect) matrix and network graph from a DeltaV FHX export.

DeltaV.name: TuningAid
DeltaV.desc: Tune DeltaV PID loops over OPC UA: run step tests, characterise the process and watch live trends.

DeltaV.name: DvTwin
DeltaV.desc: A digital twin of a DeltaV system: simulate an FHX configuration, connect to it over OPC UA, and run automated tests against it.

DeltaV.name: DVEmu
DeltaV.desc: Run a DeltaV configuration's control logic offline against a simulated plant, with 2D/3D live views and repeatable test scenarios. No DeltaV or OPC needed.

DeltaV.name: FHXVerify
DeltaV.desc: Check a DeltaV FHX export for broken references, SFC problems, naming limits and typos, fix what can be fixed automatically, and get an HTML report.

DeltaV.name: OPCBridge
DeltaV.desc: Make DeltaV's classic OPC DA data available as an OPC UA server, with live diagnostics.

DeltaV.name: Op2Live
DeltaV.desc: Convert DeltaV Operate graphics to DeltaV Live in a guided, step-by-step process, with mapping review, VBA translation, a design specification and validation tests.

DeltaV.name: OperateTools
DeltaV.desc: Report on, search, bulk-edit and compare DeltaV Operate (iFix) graphics (.grf), including tag groups and VBA, and repair broken animation links.

DeltaV.name: VIMTools
DeltaV.desc: Read DeltaV Virtual I/O Module configuration files (.vio): browse the VIM tree, see how EtherNet/IP data maps to signals, and run read-only diagnostics.

DeltaV.name: DvScan
DeltaV.desc: Finds out why a DeltaV controller shows up in the Decommissioned list and then vanishes, and says what to check next. Can reset an orphaned controller so it can be commissioned — it asks first.

DeltaV.name: DvVMManager
DeltaV.desc: Manage your DeltaV virtual machines from one place: health at a glance, one-click jobs like database export and licence updates, power and checkpoints, and file deployment. Replaces VMTools.

DeltaV.name: DVNormalizer
DeltaV.desc: Move a DeltaV database's modules onto a different module class library (PCSD by default): it matches the classes, shows what the change costs, and writes the converted modules.

DeltaV.name: UpgradeScout
DeltaV.desc: Scope a DeltaV version upgrade from the customer's own data: SMS system summary and device export, with the system FHX when you have one. Node table, v16 compatibility against Emerson's chart, dongle, warranty and subscription flags, and the upgrade estimate's quantities filled in.

Provox.name: PvxIO
Provox.desc: Convert Provox IO configuration between FHX and Excel, in either direction.

Provox.name: PvxPDX
Provox.desc: Extract tables, FSTs, operations and queries from Provox PDX files into readable output files.

Provox.name: PDXDiff
Provox.desc: Compare two folders of Provox PDX exports and get a PDF summary and an Excel log of every difference.

Provox.name: FSTDecompiler
Provox.desc: Turn Provox FST programs into readable pseudocode, stage by stage. Can also explain an FST in plain English through your work Copilot in Slipstream.

Provox.name: ODFDiff
Provox.desc: Compare two versions of an HMI configuration and see the changes as screen overlays, interactive HTML reports and an Excel change log.

Provox.name: PVXMigration
Provox.desc: Generate DeltaV migration deliverables from Provox configuration data: appendix tables, the base build workbook and a Functional Requirements document.

Virtualization.name: VMCreds
Virtualization.desc: Audit accounts and change passwords in bulk across Hyper-V virtual machines, including the scheduled tasks that use them.

Allen Bradley.name: ABComms
Allen Bradley.desc: Talk to Allen-Bradley PLCs: browse, read and write tags, manage the controller, and look up chassis modules.

Allen Bradley.name: EDSCatalog
Allen Bradley.desc: Browse EtherNet/IP device description (EDS) files: identify devices by catalog number and see their configurable parameters.

Allen Bradley.name: Logix2dv
Allen Bradley.desc: Convert Rockwell Studio 5000 programs (L5X or ACD) into proposed DeltaV modules you can import as FHX.

Allen Bradley.name: ABCommission
Allen Bradley.desc: A simpler alternative to Rockwell's BootP/DHCP tool: find EtherNet/IP devices, assign IP addresses, and read or change drive and adapter settings, usually without the EDS file or manual.

Allen Bradley.name: FTViewTools
Allen Bradley.desc: Read FactoryTalk View SE/ME displays without FactoryTalk installed: every tag, caption and expression, which displays use each tag, and inconsistent shortcuts flagged. Exports CSV and HTML.

CodeSys.name: STReader
CodeSys.desc: Turn IEC 61131-3 Structured Text programs into flow diagrams you can export as HTML or PDF.

Documentation.name: CornerPDF
Documentation.desc: Read, mark up, organise, compare and redact PDFs without Acrobat, with OCR for scans, calibrated measurements and drawing-package assembly. Works fully offline.

Documentation.name: SuperDocs
Documentation.desc: Search all your help files at once — DeltaV Books Online, other .chm and old .hlp manuals, and PDFs — in one offline library, with a hit count per manual.

Documentation.name: P&ID Reader
Documentation.desc: Pull tags, devices, symbols and line connections out of P&ID PDFs into tables and instrument loops. Can ask your work Copilot, through Slipstream, to double-check misread tags.

Documentation.name: P&ID Maker
Documentation.desc: Draw ISA-5.1 P&IDs and export them as searchable PDFs, starting from scratch, a spreadsheet, a DeltaV configuration or a P&ID Reader extraction, with standards checking as you draw.

Documentation.name: TableX
Documentation.desc: Pull tables and text out of images, scanned or digital PDFs, Word, PowerPoint and web pages into Excel or CSV. Works offline; nothing is uploaded.

Documentation.name: FnR
Documentation.desc: Find and replace across Word, Excel, PowerPoint, DeltaV FHX, Operate graphics, XML and text files, with a preview before anything changes.

Documentation.name: PunchList
Documentation.desc: Read FAT, SAT and development punch lists, whatever their column layout, with live open/closed counts. Fills the count and the retest box into the acknowledgment and builds the status report's Issues table.

AI.name: MP4Transcribe
AI.desc: Turn video and audio recordings into text or subtitles, offline: batch whole folders, pick the language or translate to English. Nothing is uploaded.

AI.name: CornerCode
AI.desc: An AI assistant for automation engineers: explain or fix code and PLC logic, research manuals, draft requirements and test plans, and ask about your DeltaV configuration. Runs on your PC, or on your work Copilot if you switch it.

AI.name: SkillExplorer
AI.desc: Install Cornerstone's AI add-ons — skills and tool servers for DeltaV FHX, graphics, OPC UA, alarms, remote machines and Emerson SMS — into Claude Code or Slipstream in one click.

AI.name: Slipstream
AI.desc: Use the Microsoft 365 Copilot that comes with your work account as a coding assistant: chat about your files, let it plan and make changes with your approval, and undo any run.

AI.name: LocalModel
AI.desc: Offline AI inference engine (Qwen2.5-Coder-7B + llama-server). Optional standalone install for air-gapped plant operation; enables local AI across CornerCode, TestPilot, and other suite tools without internet.

AI.name: TestPilot
AI.desc: Automated GUI & display test runner: open screens, verify labels and faceplates, execute navigation playbooks, and generate Before/After visual comparison reports.

Reverse Engineering.name: ByteWright
Reverse Engineering.desc: Identify an unknown file: it analyses the contents and gives a plain-language verdict on what the file is and what is inside. Works offline.

Reverse Engineering.name: Patina
Reverse Engineering.desc: Decompile Windows and Linux programs (.exe, ELF) into readable C code.

Remote.name: CornerRDP
Remote.desc: Remote-control Windows and DeltaV machines over RDP, including ones other tools cannot reach, and record repetitive jobs as reusable automations across many machines. Passwords are never saved.

Comms.name: SuperComms
Comms.desc: Read live values from plant equipment over 11 protocols — OPC UA, classic OPC, Modbus, Allen-Bradley, Siemens S7, MQTT and more — side by side, or stand in for a device when testing.

Training.name: InstrumentLab
Training.desc: Learn process instruments by running them: 31 simulated measuring technologies with worked equations, cutaway views and timed troubleshooting exercises. Nothing touches a plant.

Syncade.name: SyncadeRecipe
Syncade.desc: Read, compare and edit Syncade recipe libraries (.rax, .rxf) offline: see each recipe as a drawing and in plain language, trace where parameter values come from, generate design specifications, and check the interface to DeltaV.

Syncade.name: SyncadePackage
Syncade.desc: Review a Syncade deployment package before it goes in: list every file with its version, check scripts and SQL against 22 rules, and compare two drops. Read-only.

Syncade.name: SyncadeOrders
Syncade.desc: Check Syncade order bills (BOP, BOM, BOE and more) and equipment exports for problems before an operator hits them, and generate equipment design specifications. Exports to Excel.
